style: Realistic footage at real-time speed, not slow motion. Fast, confident camera movement. Natural true-to-life colors with no color grading and no film look. Sharp and crisp. Full-frame image edge to edge with no vignette, no black borders, no letterbox. No readable text, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.prompt: Extreme macro of a circuit board, the camera racing low across chips and gold traces as tiny LEDs blink on in sequence.
Fast dolly down a dark data center aisle between tall server racks covered in blinking blue and green status lights.
Macro of fiber optic cable ends bursting with pulses of white and blue light, the camera pushing through them.
Close-up of hands typing very fast on a mechanical keyboard in a dark room lit only by the monitor.
Extreme close-up of a developer's eyes and glasses with rapidly scrolling lines of code reflected in the lenses.
An industrial robotic arm whipping fast through precise movements on a factory line, sparks and motion.
Macro of a tweezers placing a tiny computer chip onto a circuit board, then the board lighting up.
Macro of a smartphone being assembled, a glowing screen panel snapping into the aluminum frame.
Close-up of a thumb flicking fast through a colorful app on a modern smartphone, screen glowing in a dark room, abstract interface shapes with no readable text.
Camera rushing toward a huge LED video wall pulsing with abstract colorful data patterns in a dark modern office.
Fast aerial hyperlapse over a city at night, streams of car lights flowing like data through the streets.
A small drone lifting off fast from a launch pad and banking away, propellers blurring, camera tracking it.
A person in a sleek VR headset turning their head quickly, colored light from the lenses spilling across their face in a dark room.
A laser cutter tracing a fast glowing path across a sheet of metal, bright sparks spraying.
A satellite gliding over the curve of the Earth at night with city lights below, sun flaring over the horizon.
Wide shot of a modern startup office at night, a small team working fast at glowing monitors, camera sweeping past glass walls.
Camera racing forward through a long tunnel of white LED light strips, everything streaking past.
Macro of a network switch with rows of cables plugged in and port lights flickering rapidly.
